name: How often should a mobile home foundation be inspected or re-leveled?

mainEntity.name: How often should a mobile home foundation be inspected or re-leveled?

acceptedAnswer.text: The frequency for inspecting or re-leveling a mobile home foundation depends on several factors, including the age of the home, soil conditions, and any signs of shifting. Generally, it's advisable to have a professional inspection every 5-10 years. However, if you notice issues like sticking doors or windows, cracked walls, uneven floors, or persistent leaks, a prompt inspection is recommended. Regular maintenance helps prevent more significant and costly structural problems down the line.
acceptedAnswer.description: Inspect or re-level a mobile home foundation every 5-10 years, or immediately if you notice issues like sticking doors, cracks, or uneven floors.
